# Northstar Support Service Level Schedule v2.0

## 1. Application

This version applies to tickets opened on or after 2026-04-01 00:00 CT. The version is chosen by the ticket's **open time in Central
Time**, and nothing else. A ticket keeps its version for its whole life, including credits, cap
and claim window, even if it is restored, claimed or decided after another version takes effect.

timestamp recorded in another zone (for example Eastern Daylight Time, UTC−04:00, or UTC in system
logs) is converted to CT before anything is measured. "Date" (the restoration date, the claim date
or a notice date) means the CT calendar date of the timestamp after conversion.

2.2 **Business hours** are 08:00 to 18:00 CT, Monday to Friday, except Northstar holidays (see the

whole minutes. Pauses apply only to the restoration clock; maintenance exclusions apply to both.

target is met if the event happens at or before that moment, and missed if it happens after it.
An event exactly at the moment the target elapses meets it.

ticket-creation notices do not count, and neither does a call made by the customer.

# Support Severity Guide

Northstar Support classifies severity from the business impact recorded in the ticket (its
description and notes). Test the definitions in order; the severity is the first one the recorded
impact meets.

## Severity 1: Critical

A Northstar product failure that, with **no workaround available**, either (a) stops the customer's
production or operations (a production line, a plant process, or a distribution, dispatch or
facility-operations activity cannot continue), or (b) makes NS-Cloud unavailable to **all** of the
customer's users.

## Severity 2: High

Not Severity 1, and any one of: (a) production or operations continue but are materially degraded;
(b) a control, alarming or condition-monitoring function is unavailable (not merely intermittent)
for one or more machines, lines, buildings or sites, whether or not the customer covers it with
manual checks; (c) NS-Cloud is unavailable to some, but not all, of the customer's users or sites;
(d) a Severity 1 condition with a workaround in place that needs ongoing manual effort.","origin":"stated","anchors":[]},{"passage_id":"01a13636-2af2-7132-8c92-deb0a57fdc08@1#2","doc_id":"01a13636-2af2-7132-8c92-deb0a57fdc08","version":1,"seq":2,"span":{"start":1203,"end":2064},"headings":["Support Severity Guide","Severity 3: Medium"],"text":"Not Severity 1 or 2: a function is impaired with no reduction in production output and no loss of a
control, alarming or monitoring function (intermittent faults with backfilled data, slow
performance, a failing report, a single-user error).

## Severity 4: Low

A question, how-to, documentation issue, cosmetic defect or enhancement request, with no effect on
operations.

## Who decides

The customer's reported priority (P1 to P4) is only the customer's view: it does not set the
severity and has no effect on targets, credits or escalations. Northstar may correct the severity
up or down at any time. If the impact recorded at opening meets a different severity, that severity
governs from the open time, with its clock, targets, credits and escalations. If the impact changes
after opening, the ticket is reclassified at the moment the change is recorded.","origin":"stated","anchors":[]}],"next_cursor":null,"total":2}

# Northstar Credit Policy 2026, revision 2

## 1. Purpose

Sets who may approve customer credit limits, and which customers may receive a higher limit, for
the rest of calendar 2026. Revision 2 raises the maximum credit limit for Strategic accounts.

## 2. Effective period

This policy is effective from 2026-10-01 through 2026-12-31.
It replaces the Northstar Credit Policy 2026 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026) in full for requests dated on or
after 2026-10-01.

## 3. Approval authority

Authority applies to the new total credit limit requested.

- Accounts Receivable Specialists may approve credit limits up to and including $100,000.
- Credit limits greater than $100,000 and up to and including $500,000 require Finance Manager approval.
- Credit limits greater than $500,000 require Director of Finance approval.

## 4. Concurrence

- For Strategic accounts, credit limits greater than $500,000 also require VP Sales concurrence.","origin":"stated","anchors":[]},"doc":{"doc_id":"01a13636-245d-7e61-ae2f-4512de9120a1","version":2,"title":"credit_policy_2026.md","filename":"credit_policy_2026.md"},"score":0.125,"highlights":[{"start":12,"end":18},{"start":51,"end":57},{"start":217,"end":223},{"start":294,"end":300},{"start":418,"end":424},{"start":567,"end":573},{"start":587,"end":593},{"start":619,"end":627},{"start":720,"end":726},{"start":733,"end":742},{"start":791,"end":797},{"start":837,"end":843},{"start":942,"end":948},{"start":1062,"end":1068}]}],"coverage":{"documents":38,"read":38,"not_read":[]}}

# Northstar Credit Policy 2026, revision 2

## 1. Purpose

Sets who may approve customer credit limits, and which customers may receive a higher limit, for
the rest of calendar 2026. Revision 2 raises the maximum credit limit for Strategic accounts.

## 2. Effective period

This policy is effective from 2026-10-01 through 2026-12-31.
It replaces the Northstar Credit Policy 2026 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026) in full for requests dated on or
after 2026-10-01.

## 3. Approval authority

Authority applies to the new total credit limit requested.

- Accounts Receivable Specialists may approve credit limits up to and including $100,000.
- Credit limits greater than $100,000 and up to and including $500,000 require Finance Manager approval.
- Credit limits greater than $500,000 require Director of Finance approval.

## 4. Concurrence

**SR-39802 is out of scope. Northstar's support terms don't cover the customer, so no service level could be breached and no credit is owed.**

**1. Who the customer is.** The ticket is on CRM account **CRM-2091**. That account is **Acme Industrial Supply Co.** in Akron, OH: ERP customer C-1044, DUNS 09-552-1187, a Standard account owned by **Zachary Brown**. It is not Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / C-1001, DUNS 04-812-7730). The ticket says "We're Acme. We have the Acme Platinum support plan," but the customer's name doesn't decide coverage. Only the identifiers do.

**2. Scope.** The Platinum plan belongs to Schedule C, and Schedule C covers only Acme Mfg. Holdings (DUNS 04-812-7730). It says outright that "Acme Industrial Supply Co. is a different company and is not covered." No support terms in the knowledge base cover CRM-2091 for NS-Edge or any other product. Under the escalation procedure, that makes the ticket **out of scope**. It gets best-effort handling: no targets apply, nothing can be breached, no credit is owed, and the Severity 1 escalations don't apply.

**3. True severity: Severity 1, used only for internal priority.** All NS-Edge gateways at the distribution center were offline, picking had stopped and there was no workaround. That stops a distribution activity, which is the Severity 1 definition. The customer's "P1" label played no part in this.

**4. Times, converted to Central Time.**
- The ticket was opened by phone on Monday 2026-08-10 at 05:05 CDT (06:05 EDT).
- An engineer responded at 06:40 CDT.
- Service was restored at 13:20 CDT.

For reference only: on a covered Severity 1 ticket, a 95-minute response and an 8 h 15 m restoration would both have missed their targets (30 minutes and 4 hours). Because the ticket is out of scope, none of this is a breach.

**What Northstar owes:**
- **Notify the account owner:** Zachary Brown, account owner of CRM-2091, must be notified within 10 business hours of the open time. The ticket opened before business hours on a Monday that isn't a holiday, so business hours started at 08:00. The deadline was **2026-08-10 18:00 CDT**. The ticket record doesn't show whether this was done.
- **Decline the credit claim in writing:** Amy Barrett's claim arrived 2026-08-14 at 09:00 CDT. Out-of-scope claims are declined, and the decision goes out like any other. **Marcus Adeyemi** (Director of Customer Support) had to send the written decline, with the reason (no support terms cover CRM-2091), by **2026-09-13**. The record doesn't show whether it was sent.
- **Nothing else:** no credit memo, no root-cause finding, and no Severity 1 escalations (Support Escalation Manager, Director of Customer Support, VP Sales or CRO).

**What the customer must do:** no service-level obligations apply, because the customer has no support terms. For reference, they did call the issue in by phone and sent the claim in writing within what would have been the 30-day window, but neither creates any entitlement. To get SLA coverage, Acme Industrial Supply Co. would need its own support agreement.
